cause: A provider disconnected after emitting a valid partial tool-call fragment, but the adapter had not recorded public provider progress and retried the request.

evidence.ref: tests/test_llm_providers.py::test_openai_adapter_does_not_retry_after_partial_tool_call_activity failed before the adapter fix: expected one upstream request, observed two.

impact: A partial provider response could duplicate an upstream planning request and consume additional provider work before returning a failure.
lesson: Record recoverable provider progress as soon as a valid tool-call argument prefix is received, so disconnects after partial calls are not retried.

cause: A provider stream remained pending indefinitely while the caller cancellation signal was already set, and the model adapter waited only on provider progress.

evidence.ref: tests/test_llm_providers.py::test_openai_adapter_abort_event_interrupts_a_hung_provider_stream failed before the adapter fix: the adapter exceeded the 0.1 second abort bound.

impact: A cancelled Notebook request could remain visibly working until an unrelated provider timeout instead of stopping promptly.
lesson: Wait for provider progress and the abort signal as competing events, and make cancellation win over a late provider completion.

cause: A complete non-object tool argument payload was treated as a recoverable partial prefix, so the malformed response was not given the bounded retry path.

evidence.ref: tests/test_llm_providers.py::test_openai_adapter_retries_after_complete_non_object_tool_json failed during resilience implementation: expected two requests, observed one.

impact: Malformed complete tool arguments could terminate a planning attempt without the intended single bounded retry and diagnostic.
lesson: Distinguish a recoverable JSON object prefix from a complete scalar or array payload before deciding whether provider progress prevents retry.
